The Flying Fijians are preparing for the upcoming Nations Championship next month where they will face France on Monday 9th at 8.10am, before taking on Ireland on the 15th and Italy on the 22nd.

The Flying Fijians have climbed to ninth place in the latest World Rugby rankings .

The Rugby World Cup begins on the 1st of October 2027.

item.title: Nadi bank on mental maturity and lessons learned to challenge Nadroga in Skipper Cup final
item.description: The Nadi Senior Men's Skipper Cup team heads into tomorrow's final against Nadroga with greater mental maturity and valuable lessons learned from previous matches, confident of putting up a strong performance. Speaking during the launch of the Pio Bosco and Farebrother Trophies, Nadi coach Cohan Politini says Nadroga will do what champion teams do.
item.content:encoded:
The Nadi Senior Men's Skipper Cup team heads into tomorrow's final against Nadroga with greater mental maturity and valuable lessons learned from previous matches, confident of putting up a strong performance.

Speaking during the launch of the Pio Bosco and Farebrother Trophies, Nadi coach Cohan Politini says Nadroga will do what champion teams do.

Insert Nadro Coach on Nadroga game 30th Oct ML

He says the players are handling the pressure well ahead of the final, adding that the key is to stick to their game plan and maintain their routine. Nadi will take on Nadroga in the senior Skipper Cup final at 3pm, while Namosi will defend their Marama Cup title against Nasinu at 1pm. Nadi will also face Nadroga in the Under-20 final at 11am. All three finals will be held at Churchill Park in Lautoka tomorrow.
